content.user_title: Optimize Form Completion and Lead Quality
content.value_statement: Forms lose users when fields, copy, and errors add friction. This skill audits non-signup forms and recommends focused changes that improve completion and lead quality.
actual_capabilities: Scores a form with a 0 to 100 Form Health and Friction Index.
Reviews field necessity, field order, labels, placeholders, and error handling.
Recommends required and optional fields with clear business justification.
Suggests submit button copy, validation messages, and layout improvements.
Creates A/B test hypotheses and measurement guidance for form changes.
Flags when structural fixes should happen before tactical experiments.
limitations: Does not cover signup or account registration flows.
Needs form details, analytics, or screenshots for the most specific advice.
Does not replace legal review for compliance-sensitive fields.
Cannot prove lift without a properly measured experiment.

use_cases.title: Improve Lead Capture Forms
use_cases.description: Audit required fields, value copy, and friction points before changing a campaign form.

use_cases.title: Refine Demo Request Forms
use_cases.description: Balance sales qualification needs with completion rate and clear next-step expectations.

use_cases.title: Reduce Checkout Abandonment
use_cases.description: Review non-account checkout forms for mobile usability, validation, trust, and field order.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Form Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a simple form.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the form-cro skill to audit this non-signup form. Score it and list the top five fixes. Form details: [paste fields, copy, and goal].

prompt_templates.title: Lead Quality Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Balance completion rate with useful submissions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the form-cro skill to review this lead form. Identify fields to keep, remove, or make optional. Business use of each field: [paste details].

prompt_templates.title: Mobile Friction Diagnosis
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the form-cro skill to diagnose mobile friction for this form. Include keyboard types, touch targets, layout, validation, and submit states. Details: [paste observations].

prompt_templates.title: Experiment Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the form-cro skill to create an experiment plan for this form. Include baseline metrics, hypotheses, variants, risks, and success measures. Context: [paste analytics and constraints].

output_examples.input: A seven-field demo request form asks for name, email, phone, company, role, company size, and project details.
output_examples.output: The skill scores the form as usable with friction, recommends moving phone to optional, clarifies project details, and proposes a shorter first step.

output_examples.input: A checkout form has vague errors, no privacy reassurance, and cramped fields on mobile.
output_examples.output: The skill highlights error handling and mobile layout as priority issues, then suggests specific messages, larger fields, and trust copy near payment.

output_examples.input: A quote form collects many technical details before showing value or response timing.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends leading with value, splitting high-effort questions into later steps, and testing a lighter initial request.

best_practices: Share the form goal, field list, required fields, and what happens after submission.
Provide analytics such as completion rate, field drop-off, error rate, and device mix.
Use recommendations as hypotheses and validate important changes with measured tests.
anti_patterns: Asking the skill to remove fields without explaining business or compliance needs.
Using it for signup, login, password, or account creation flows.
Testing many form changes at once without clear measurement or ownership.

faq.question: What forms does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports lead capture, contact, demo request, application, survey, quote, and non-account checkout forms.

faq.question: Does it work for signup forms?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly excludes signup and account registration flows.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the form goal, field list, labels, required fields, current metrics, and known constraints.

faq.question: Can it improve lead quality?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends field choices that reduce friction while preserving useful qualification data.

faq.question: Does it create analytics tracking code?
faq.answer: No. It defines metrics and tracking needs, but it does not implement tracking code.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
